How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Madras Patent Agent Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 26-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Madras to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Madras Patent Agent Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the online application for the Patent Agent post at IIT Madras is 26 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Patent Agent post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Patent Agent post in the IIT Madras recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply Online for the IIT Madras Patent Agent recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification for the Patent Agent position?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Registered Indian Patent Agent, with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics and Communication, and 0-5 years of IP-related experience.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for IIT Madras Patent Agent recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Patent Agent post at IIT Madras?
faq.answer: The salary for the Patent Agent position is Rs.25,000/- upwards per month, based on experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for the Patent Agent post?
faq.answer: The Patent Agent position at IIT Madras is a Contract-based job.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Patent Agent role?
faq.answer: The selection process includes shortlisting, a test/interview, and document verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for the Patent Agent post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Patent Agent position is Chennai, Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website to apply for IIT Madras recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website to apply and find more details is https://icandsr.iitm.ac.in/.
